summary: Creates IANA registries for code points used in MPLS LSP Ping, including Downstream Mapping flags, multipath types, pad TLVs and address types. These had been defined in RFCs 4379 and 6424 without registries. It was replaced by RFC 8029.

eli5.summary: A notebook where every special code used by a network testing tool gets written down, so nobody picks the same code for different meanings. It was later replaced by RFC 8029.
